# Fixture Instance Surfaces

This page exists inside a **published** package, at the package root beside
`lib/`, exactly where a real module ships one. It is what
`specs/110-instance-repository/` T101 asserts an instance's generated navigation
can name — a page whose real path is under `node_modules`, which in *this*
repository would be `overlay:check`'s `foreign` verdict and in a client's
instance is the whole point.
